newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnia Moslem-Croat federation gets new leaders.
newsitem.headline: Bosnia Moslem-Croat federation gets new leaders.

text.p: Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation parliament appointed a new Croat president of the federation on Tuesday.
Vladimir Soljic was named president and Ejup Ganic, a Moslem who served as a vice-president since the federation agreement was signed in 1994, was confirmed as his deputy.
Soljic, a former federation defence minister, replaced Kresimir Zubak now seated as a Croat member of Bosnia's three-man presidency.
